facts.text: Melanie made a bowl with a black and white flower design.

evidence.quote: Look at this! [image: a photo of a bowl with a black and white flower design]
Thanks, Caroline! Yeah, I made this bowl in my class.

facts.text: Melanie described pottery as a form of therapy that helps her express herself and get creative.

evidence.quote: It's like therapy for me, letting me express myself and get creative.
Pottery is a huge part of my life, not just a hobby - it helps me express my emotions.

facts.text: Melanie took a pottery class and found the process to be rewarding and joyful.

evidence.quote: It took some work, but I'm pretty proud of it.
Clay is incredible, it brings me so much joy.
